today_in_history_posts.title: Detailed protocol design for routed multi-transaction CoinSwap
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- CoinSwap implementation enhances Bitcoin privacy by complicating transaction surveillance.
- The protocol includes multi-transaction features and uses a liquidity market with role-specific conditions.
- It involves a structure of multisig and HTLC transactions, requiring collaborative public-private key generation.

today_in_history_posts.title: Dynamic Commitments: Upgrading Channels Without On-Chain Transactions
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Rusty discusses implementing `commit_switch` and `commit_switch_reply` for double-opt-in.
- He recommends a linear progression of channel types, prioritizing newer types.
- Proposes three-step upgrade to anchor_outputs, requiring a feature bit for upgrades.

today_in_history_posts.title: Deflationary money is a Good Thing
today_in_history_posts.summary:
- Passive and active investments differ in management involvement and asset interaction.
- Issues with passive investment include asset underutilization and misaligned management incentives.
- The blog proposes combining inflationary and deflationary currencies to stabilize economies.
